title: Cozy Game for AI Agents, Now 30% Off Available on macOS and Windows with a one-time purchase.
author: FreshnessAi
selftext:
Hey everyone!

Termi Protocol is a desktop experience that turns the work of AI coding agents into a living, interactive room.

Instead of only watching terminal logs and text output, you can see your agents sitting at their desks, reading files, writing code, running commands, resting, sleeping, or exercising when they are not working. Their actions inside the room visually reflect what is happening during your real development session.

The room also includes interactive features such as darts, Pomodoro focus sessions, trash collection, multiple camera angles, and customizable cats and dogs that grow as you spend more time working on your projects.

There is also a humorous whip animation when an agent makes a mistake. It is entirely visual, does not affect the agent, and does not consume any tokens. :D

Termi Protocol is designed to make long coding sessions feel more understandable, lively, and enjoyable while keeping the real terminal workflow intact.

It was built with Three.js and AI assisted development. AI was used during the development process, and the product itself is designed around visualizing AI coding agents.

**A quick note: I created the assets and most of the sound effects using ai, folks.**

It currently supports **macOS and Windows**.

You can try the browser demo without purchasing anything. The demo uses mock data to show how the room and agent animations work:

**Demo:** [https://termiprotocol.com/demo](https://termiprotocol.com/demo)

You can find more information and download the desktop app here:

**Website:** [https://termiprotocol.com](https://termiprotocol.com/)

I would love to hear your honest thoughts on the room design, animations, visual clarity, and overall art direction.

Thanks for reading! 🙏

replies.author: FreshnessAi
replies.body: I think times have changed; I developed games using C# and Unity between 2013 and 2024 they racked up over 50 million downloads but looking back now, I can't help but think about how we used to write everything by hand :D
